fields.yield_2016APV: sum of weight_nominal in the 2016APV signal ntuple, fit range (mll > 60.0 && mll < 120.0 && met > 200.0 && met < 1200.0); absent if the mass point has no 2016APV ntuple
fields.yield_2016: sum of weight_nominal in the 2016 signal ntuple, fit range (mll > 60.0 && mll < 120.0 && met > 200.0 && met < 1200.0); absent if the mass point has no 2016 ntuple
fields.yield_2017: sum of weight_nominal in the 2017 signal ntuple, fit range (mll > 60.0 && mll < 120.0 && met > 200.0 && met < 1200.0); absent if the mass point has no 2017 ntuple
fields.yield_2018: sum of weight_nominal in the 2018 signal ntuple, fit range (mll > 60.0 && mll < 120.0 && met > 200.0 && met < 1200.0); absent if the mass point has no 2018 ntuple
fields.yield_run2: sum of yield_{year} over 2016APV, 2016, 2017, 2018; absent unless all of them are available
fields.yield_450fb: yield_run2 * PROJECTED_LUMI/LUMI_RUN2 (450/137.62); the datacard signal rate. absent if yield_run2 is (the mass point is then skipped)
fields.yield_run2_total: sum of yield_{year} over 2016APV, 2016, 2017, 2018; absent unless all of them are available
fields.xsec_2d: Higgsino-Bino cross-sections (relevant for all LSP masses), separated by 13 TeV and 13.6 TeV
fields.xsec_1d: GMSB cross-sections (only relevant for LSP mass = 1 GeV), separated by 13 TeV and 13.6 TeV
fields.xsec_source: luna-zhmet/histogramming/helpers: run2 from xsec.h, run3 from xsec_13p6TeV.h, looked up by the NLSP mass (mchi)
